newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.200 to off 0.200 cent. higher live and beef prices supportive to August but back months seen weak as increased fed supplies ahead.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Further gains in corn futures and latest CME feeder index lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.200 cent. Steady to lower cash hog indications as packers cutting kills. But Japan's plan to cut tariffs on pork imports in August still supportive.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.300 cent. Out-of-town report seen mildly bullish and cash bellies up on reduced hog kills.
